## Activity

This report covers activity at Market Eye Clinic during March 2025. The site recorded 450 captures during the month. This represents the total capture activity submitted for review and provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures reported below. No additional changes to the operating arrangements were identified in the available monthly information.

## Image quality

Of the 450 captures, 99 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 22.0. These images could not be used for grading and should continue to be monitored through routine quality assurance. The result indicates that image acquisition remains an area for local review, particularly where repeat capture or further staff support may be required.

## Grading

A total of 97 captures were recorded as referable following grading. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This provides an indication of the typical time taken for cases to progress through the grading process during March 2025. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month. Continued monitoring of capture quality, ungradable images and grading timeliness is appropriate as part of routine site operations.
